name: nui.nvim component usage
description: nui.Split for panel layouts (thread panel uses right-side split). nui.Popup for floating windows (comment popup). nui.Menu for context-aware action menus (dynamic items, focus navigation, on_submit callback) — planned, not yet implemented. nui.Input for single-line text input — planned for reply input (Phase 12). nui.Layout for composing mixed read-only + editable sections — planned for reply area (Phase 12). Always unmount Layout (not individual components) when closing composed layouts. Map close keys (q, Esc) in ALL buffers created by a Layout, not just the focused one.

name: Extmark-based thread panel formatting
description: Thread panel (lua/nit/display/thread_panel.lua) uses nvim_buf_set_extmark for rich formatting instead of plain text. Each comment block rendered with extmarks for author name, timestamp, body lines, and separator. Highlight groups applied per-extmark for color differentiation. Hint registry is a module-level table inside lua/nit/display/thread_panel.lua (not a separate file): register_hints() at line 126, clear_hints() at line 133, build_winbar() at line 146 (builds winbar string from hint registry). Hints are rendered in the winbar (vim.wo[active_panel.winid].winbar = M.build_winbar(thread)) — not as extmarks in the buffer. See commit 3fc6211 for extmark implementation.

name: Highlight group naming convention
description: All nit.nvim highlight groups use Nit* prefix. Defined in lua/nit/ui/highlights.lua (not display/highlights.lua — that file handles extmark-based line highlight placement for NitCommentHighlight only). Groups: NitCommentSign, NitCommentResolvedSign, NitCommentOutdatedSign, NitThreadTitle, NitThreadTitleResolved, NitThreadAuthor, NitThreadHintKey, NitThreadHintLabel, NitCommentHighlight, NitThreadComment, NitThreadCommentAlt. Linked to standard Neovim groups where appropriate. New highlight groups must be added to lua/nit/ui/highlights.lua setup() function to be registered on plugin load.

title: All nit UI components must support ? to show keybinding help
rationale: Keybinding hints don't scale when shown inline (winbar/statusline/extmarks). A consistent ? binding across all UI components (thread panel, comment popup, future context menu) provides discoverable help without cluttering the interface. Each component reads from its own hint_registry and renders a nui.Popup with the registered keybindings.

name: help_popup reusable keybinding popup
description: help_popup.lua: reusable help popup for any nit UI component. M.show(hints) takes {key,label}[] and renders a centered nui.Popup with aligned key/label columns. M.toggle(hints) open/close. Follows comment_popup.lua pattern. All nit components wire ? → help_popup.toggle(hint_registry).

name: zebra-stripe get_line_highlights
description: get_line_highlights(lines, author_indices) in thread_panel.lua maps 1-based line index to extmark opts for alternating comment backgrounds. Even comment_index => line_hl_group='NitThreadCommentAlt', odd => 'NitThreadComment'. Author lines detected via author_indices table (set by format_thread()). update() calls this and sets hl_eol=true on each returned entry.
Stale nui.Split panel state: closing split externally (:q, :close) leaves active_panel non-nil but with invalid winid.
resolution: is_open() and show() must validate window with nvim_win_is_valid() and unmount stale panels before creating new ones.

name: Structured author_indices for highlight assignment
description: format_thread() returns (lines, author_indices) table mapping 1-based line indices to true for author lines, used by get_line_highlights() instead of regex-matching rendered strings. Prevents false positives when comment body matches author line pattern.

showbreak='' reverts to global for global-local options: setting scope='local' with empty string clears the local override, making the window inherit the global value. Confirmed: nvim_set_option_value('showbreak','LOCAL',{scope='local'}) → local=[LOCAL]; then ('showbreak','',{scope='local'}) → local=[GLOBAL]. Same applies to vim.wo and nui win_options.
resolution: Use a non-empty value (e.g. showbreak=' ', a single space) to create a genuine local override that won't revert to global.

description: breakindent=true causes line_hl_group gap on continuation visual lines: Neovim renders the breakindent indent space with the window background (NormalFloat), not the extmark line_hl_group. This creates a visible color gap at the left edge of zebra-striped wrapped lines.
resolution: Set breakindent=false and showbreak=' ' (single space). The space is rendered as part of the line and IS covered by line_hl_group, while also providing the same 1-column visual indent as breakindent would.

name: NitThreadComment for odd zebra rows
description: Defined in highlights.lua at 5% accent blend on NormalFloat bg (half opacity of NitThreadCommentAlt's 10%). Odd comments use NitThreadComment, even use NitThreadCommentAlt. Both applied to ALL lines of each comment via get_line_highlights() — the elseif is_even guard was a bug leaving odd body lines unhighlighted.

name: reply_input window lifecycle
description: editable input window created with nvim_open_win split='below' targeting panel winid. Guards on all mutating functions. Use vim.cmd('stopinsert') not feedkeys to exit insert mode synchronously from a Lua keymap callback.

name: thread_menu nui popup pattern
description: context-aware action menu using nui.popup, same lifecycle as help_popup.lua. open(thread, callbacks) shows Resolve/Unresolve based on thread.isResolved. Callbacks table keeps menu decoupled from orchestration.

name: thread panel observer subscription
description: subscribe to 'comments' observer in show() via observers.subscribe(), store unsubscribe fn in module state, call it first in close() before UI teardown. on_comments_changed() looks up updated thread via data.get_thread() and calls M.update().

name: viewer-right-align
description: viewer login right-alignment: format_thread reads data.get_viewer_login() at top; pads viewer headers with string.rep(' ', PANEL_WIDTH - #trimmed) .. trimmed; get_line_highlights returns text_col = #line - #vim.trim(line) for extmark col offset; graceful degradation when viewer_login is nil

name: WinClosed autocmd cleanup
description: Register augroup-scoped WinClosed autocmds for both panel.winid and reply_input.get_winid() after mount. Both autocmds call M.close(). Use a closing boolean guard in M.close() to block re-entrant calls. Call nvim_clear_autocmds({group=augroup}) at the top of M.close() before unmounting.

name: wincmd= equalization after nui split mount
description: Call vim.cmd('wincmd =') immediately after panel:mount(), then restore panel width with nvim_win_set_width(panel.winid, PANEL_WIDTH). Repeat pcall(vim.cmd, 'wincmd =') in M.close() after unmount. Prevents the split from stealing columns from adjacent windows instead of distributing evenly.

name: nui popup action dispatch with CR
description: Create an actions table parallel to the lines table. Map 'r' to actions[1]. Map '<CR>' to a dispatcher that reads nvim_win_get_cursor line index and calls actions[line_index]. Enables Enter to activate any menu item by cursor position.

name: build_menu_items pattern
description: thread_menu.lua exports build_menu_items(opts) returning MenuItem[] in order: resolve (always), quote-reply (comment+on_quote_reply guard), edit (comment+on_edit_comment+viewer_login match+_optimistic_id==nil), apply-suggestion (comment+on_apply_suggestion+body has suggestion fenced block). open() derives lines/actions/keymaps dynamically from items; skips q close keymap if any item uses key q.

name: comment-range-tracking
description: format_thread returns CommentRange[] as third value: each entry has comment_index (1-based), start_line, end_line. Separator blank lines between comments fall OUTSIDE all ranges. Module stores current_ranges and selected_comment_idx as module state; both reset in M.update() (thread change) and M.close().

name: selection-ns-pattern
description: thread_panel.lua uses dedicated selection_ns ('nit_thread_selection') at priority 300 for NitThreadSelected line_hl_group. redraw_selection() clears namespace then re-applies per-line extmarks for the selected CommentRange. Called from _select_comment(), cleared on thread change and close. cursor_to_selected() moves cursor to range.start_line after j/k. _format_quote(comment) exported as M._format_quote for testability.
